from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel

class CommandPayload(BaseModel):
    command: str

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.sandbox_pool = PrewarmedSandboxPool()
    await app.state.sandbox_pool.initialize_pool()
    yield
    await app.state.sandbox_pool.shutdown()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
router = APIRouter(prefix="/sandboxes")

@router.post("/{sandbox_id}/exec")
async def execute_in_sandbox(
    sandbox_id: str,
    payload: CommandPayload,
    request: Request,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    pool: PrewarmedSandboxPool = request.app.state.sandbox_pool
    sandbox = await pool.get_sandbox(sandbox_id)
    if not sandbox:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Sandbox container not active")
    if sandbox.owner_id != user.id and not user.is_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: user is not authorized to execute commands in this sandbox")

    exec_result = await sandbox.run_command(payload.command)
    return {"sandbox_id": sandbox_id, "stdout": exec_result.stdout, "exit_code": exec_result.exit_code}
